subject: [PATCH v2 4/5] proc/task_mmu: read proc/pid/smaps_rollup under per-vma lock

reviews.author: Suren Baghdasaryan
reviews.summary: reviewer noted that smap_gather_stats() skips the first ordinary VMA and potentially the first VMA after unmapped gaps, leading to underreporting of RSS, PSS, swap, and other accumulated values
reviews.raw_body:
Oops, you are right. I didn't realize the first VMA would be silently
skipped. I'll fix it. Thanks!

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue in the Linux kernel where the proc/pid/smaps_rollup file underreports RSS, PSS, swap, and other accumulated values due to skipping the first VMA after unmapped gaps or at the start of a process's memory map. The fix involves initializing last_vma_end to the maximum of the current end of the previous VMA and the start of the current VMA, ensuring that smap_gather_stats() correctly gathers statistics from all VMAs.
